industrialItems.title: Water Softening System
industrialItems.desc: Industrial water softening systems that remove hardness and limescale, protecting your boilers and equipment.

industrialItems.title: Reverse Osmosis (RO)
industrialItems.desc: High-flow reverse osmosis purification systems for factories, hotels, and large businesses. 24/7 operation.

industrialItems.title: Separator Filters
industrialItems.desc: Separators that remove sand, sediment, and large particles using centrifugal force without chemicals. The first-line solution for irrigation systems and industrial equipment protection.

industrialItems.title: Multimedia Sand Filters
industrialItems.desc: Multi-stage filtration with sand, anthracite, and gravel layers for crystal-clear water. A reliable pre-treatment solution for high-volume applications.

industrialItems.title: Cartridge Filters
industrialItems.desc: Precision filtration with cartridge filters of different micron ratings. Used as a protective barrier before reverse osmosis and UV systems.

industrialItems.title: Filter Media
industrialItems.desc: Activated carbon, zeolite, quartz sand, and special media materials. Consumables that directly determine the efficiency of filtration systems.

industrialItems.title: Ultraviolet Systems
industrialItems.desc: Disinfection systems that permanently neutralize bacteria and viruses with UV-C light. Leaves no chemical residue, elevating drinking water safety to the highest level.

industrialItems.title: Chemical Dosing Systems
industrialItems.desc: Automatic dosing units that deliver chlorine, acid, base, and other treatment chemicals to water at precise flow rates. An indispensable system for facilities meeting discharge standards.

industrialItems.title: Disinfectant Chemicals
industrialItems.desc: Certified disinfectant products used in water treatment and hygiene processes. Safely used for well water, tank cleaning, and process water disinfection.

About.sub: Residential and industrial water purification in Izmir since 2002
About.storyP1: When we stepped into the water purification industry in 2002, there were only a handful of large companies operating in this field in Turkey. Founded on our founder's industry expertise, years of accumulated knowledge, and commitment to quality, the ADAY Water Purification Systems brand was born.
About.storyP2: Our founding story began with our founder's decision to combine the experience gained during his tenure as the Aegean Region Director at one of the industry's pioneering companies with his own vision. In the early years, we sold ready-made water purification devices, but over time we set out with the goal of becoming a brand that not only sells, but also designs, develops, and manufactures its own products.
About.storyP3: In 2015, we made a major investment to create our plastic injection molds and began manufacturing our own device casings. We use only NSF and FDA approved, quality-standard-compliant components in our internal systems. This resulted in a strong brand that combines aesthetics, durability, and high performance.
About.storyP4: Our brand name represents our belief and goal of entering the industry as a strong 'candidate' (aday in Turkish). Today, while we primarily serve the residential water purification market in Izmir, we provide solutions across Turkey for industrial projects and wholesale operations.
